title: Field Handbook
description: This project was made for one of my design courses, which required us to do multiple page booklet on the topic of Hybrid Creatures. I decided to go with a website format to make it more interactive and engaging, along with the 3D model viewer, added to immerse viewers into the experience and fully convey the message

media.caption: Cursor movement reactive landing page made using three.js' raycast system
Built-in model viewer for enhanced user interaction
